SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM knowledge AS k
WHERE k.title = 'Restore PA-3220 connection queue and restart monitoring service'
  AND k.state = 'published'
  AND k.visibility = 'external'
  AND k.owner_id = 32
  AND k.product_id = 128;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM interaction AS i
WHERE i.case_id = 5
  AND i.account_id = 1
  AND i.contact_id = 123
  AND i.channel = 'email'
  AND i.status = 'handled'
  AND i.interacted_user = 32;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM notification AS n
WHERE n.case_id = 5
  AND n.email = 'elizabeth.chase32@servicenow.com'
  AND n.type = 'solution_proposal'
  AND n.knowledge_id = 370;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customer_case AS c
WHERE c.case_id = 10
  AND c.state = 'closed';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customer_case AS c
WHERE c.case_id = 5
  AND c.state = 'resolved';
